verdict.rationale: Adyen's relayed authorisation sends a webhook for each authorisation request with the transaction data, and your server approves or refuses it in real time within a documented 2000 ms window. If you don't respond in time, you choose the fallback yourself: default approval or default refusal, configured in the Customer Area. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the latency budget and fallback behavior in production.
